title: Shane and the Big Hill
description: A bell, a puddle, and a hill that takes one more push.
subtitle: A bike ride brings a puddle, a steep hill, and one more push.

cover.alt: Shane speeding through a giant splash puddle on his bicycle while Alex cheers.

blocks.html: Click went Shane’s helmet buckle. Dad checked the strap, then the brakes on Shane’s red and blue bike. “Ready?” he asked.
Shane rang his little silver bell. Ding! “Now I am.” They rolled down the path together. Dad rode close enough to talk, but Shane chose the way.

blocks.alt: Alex clicking the helmet strap on 5-year-old Shane who is sitting on his red and blue bicycle with a shiny bell in the driveway.
blocks.caption: Helmets on and bikes ready to roll.

blocks.html: At the bend, Shane saw a puddle across the trail. He slowed down. “Can I go through it?” Dad checked that it was shallow. “You can. Keep your wheels straight.”

🗣️ Say it with Shane

Click. Ring. Roll.
Shane aimed for the middle. The front wheel touched the water. Then the back wheel followed.
Splash! Cold drops flew onto his legs. Dad got a few drops too. Shane laughed and rang his bell. “Did you see that?” “Every bit of it,” said Dad.

blocks.alt: Shane riding his bicycle right through a big splashy puddle in the park with water spraying high as Alex rides alongside laughing.
blocks.caption: Shane rides through the puddle.

blocks.html: Around the next turn stood the Big Hill. It looked much taller from the bottom. Shane stopped smiling for a moment. “That’s a lot of uphill,” he said. Dad stopped beside him. “We can go slowly. I’ll stay with you.”

🗣️ Say it with Shane

One more push.
Shane pedaled. The hill pushed back. He pedaled again. His legs felt tired, and the top still looked far away.
“One more push,” said Dad. Shane pushed. Then one more. Then one more. At last his front wheel rolled onto flat ground.

blocks.alt: Alex and Shane standing triumphantly side by side at the top of the hill with their bikes overlooking a golden sunset as Shane rings his bell.
blocks.caption: Shane reaches the top of the Big Hill.

blocks.html: From the top, he could see the puddle shining below. It looked tiny now. “I did the whole hill,” he said, almost to himself.
Dad smiled. Shane rang his bell three times. Ding! Ding! Ding! They rested while the evening sky turned orange. Then they took the easy path home.

🗣️ Say it with Shane

I did it!
